```{r add metadata Koenig}
Clinical_data <- read_excel("/scratch/gbonaz/Heart_datasets/Koenig_2022/Koenig_et_al_2022_Selected_clinical_info.xlsx")
```


```{r DE Koenig}
# ---- settings ----
celltype_col <- "new_cell_type"   # your identity column
sample_col   <- "Sample"          # pseudobulk sample id
group_col    <- "Group"           # DCM vs Donor (HC)

min_pct_cells_gene <- 1      # keep genes expressed in >1% of cells (within that cell type)
min_libsize        <- 5e4    # keep samples with pseudobulk lib.size > 5e4
fdr_thresh         <- 0.05
lfc_thresh         <- 0.5

out_dir <- here::here(output_dir_data, "DE_by_celltype_Koenig")
if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)

# ---- containers ----
celltypes <- levels(Koenig[[celltype_col]][, 1])
celltypes <- celltypes[!is.na(celltypes)]

# add "All_cells" as an extra pseudo cell type (runs DE on all cells together)
celltypes <- c("All_cells", celltypes)

results_Koenig <- vector("list", length(celltypes))
signif_Koenig  <- vector("list", length(celltypes))
names(results_Koenig) <- celltypes
names(signif_Koenig)  <- celltypes

# optional: collect basic QC / status per celltype
qc_Koenig <- data.frame(
  cell_type = celltypes,
  n_cells = NA_integer_,
  n_samples_kept = NA_integer_,
  n_genes_tested = NA_integer_,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# ---- loop ----
for (ct in celltypes) {
  message("Running DE for cell type: ", ct)

  # subset to one cell type (special case: All_cells)
  if (ct == "All_cells") {
    data_ct <- Koenig
    data_ct$celltype_all <- "All_cells"   # constant label for pseudobulk "cluster"
    ct_cluster_col <- "celltype_all"
  } else {
    data_ct <- subset(Koenig, subset = !!as.name(celltype_col) == ct)
    ct_cluster_col <- celltype_col
  }

  qc_Koenig$n_cells[qc_Koenig$cell_type == ct] <- ncol(data_ct)


  # if too few cells, skip
  if (ncol(data_ct) < 100) {
    warning("Skipping ", ct, " (too few cells: ", ncol(data_ct), ")")
    next
  }

  # percent of cells expressing each gene (within this cell type)
  expr_matrix <- GetAssayData(object = data_ct, assay = "RNA", slot = "counts")
  non_zero_cells <- rowSums(expr_matrix > 0)
  total_cells <- ncol(expr_matrix)
  percent_cells <- (non_zero_cells / total_cells) * 100
  percent_stats <- data.frame(gene = rownames(expr_matrix), percentCells = percent_cells)

  keep_genes_pct <- rownames(dplyr::filter(percent_stats, percentCells > 1))

  # pseudobulk
  pb <- Seurat2PB(data_ct, sample = sample_col, cluster = ct_cluster_col)
  colnames(pb) <- pb$samples$sample

  # keep genes based on % cells
  pb <- pb[keep_genes_pct, ]

  # keep samples by lib size
  keep_samples <- pb$samples$lib.size > min_libsize
  pb <- pb[, keep_samples, keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
  qc_Koenig$n_samples_kept[qc_Koenig$cell_type == ct] <- ncol(pb)

  # if too few samples, skip
  if (ncol(pb) < 10) {
    warning("Skipping ", ct, " (too few samples after filtering: ", ncol(pb), ")")
    next
  }

  # match metadata to pseudobulk samples
  metadata_ct <- data_ct@meta.data %>%
    dplyr::select(!!sample_col, Age, Sex, !!group_col, Pre_Op_EF, Pre_Op_CO_L_min, HTN) %>%
    unique()
  colnames(metadata_ct)[colnames(metadata_ct) == sample_col] <- "Sample"
  rownames(metadata_ct) <- metadata_ct$Sample

  metadata_ct <- metadata_ct[match(pb$samples$sample, metadata_ct$Sample), , drop = FALSE]

  # sanity check
  if (!all(metadata_ct$Sample == pb$samples$sample)) {
    stop("Sample order mismatch for cell type: ", ct)
  }

  group <- factor(metadata_ct[[group_col]])
  if (!all(c("DCM", "Donor") %in% levels(group))) {
    warning("Skipping ", ct, " (Group levels not as expected: ", paste(levels(group), collapse=", "), ")")
    next
  }

  design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + group)
  colnames(design) <- levels(group)

  contrast <- makeContrasts(
    DCM_vs_HC = DCM - Donor,
    levels = design
  )

  # edgeR pipeline (as in your code)
  pb <- normLibSizes(pb)
  pb <- estimateDisp(pb, design)

  fit <- glmQLFit(pb, design, robust = TRUE)
  fit <- glmQLFTest(fit, contrast = contrast)

  results_ct <- topTags(fit, n = Inf)$table
  results_ct$gene <- rownames(results_ct)

  # merge percent expressed
  results_ct <- merge(results_ct, percent_stats[, c("gene", "percentCells")], by = "gene", all.x = FALSE)

  # up/down annotation (same thresholds as you used)
  results_ct$diff_exp <- ifelse(
    results_ct$logFC >  lfc_thresh & results_ct$FDR < fdr_thresh, "Increased",
    ifelse(results_ct$logFC < -lfc_thresh & results_ct$FDR < fdr_thresh, "Decreased", "Not significant")
  )

  signif_ct <- results_ct %>%
    dplyr::filter(FDR < fdr_thresh, abs(logFC) > lfc_thresh) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(FDR)

  qc_Koenig$n_genes_tested[qc_Koenig$cell_type == ct] <- nrow(results_ct)

  # store in lists
  results_Koenig[[ct]] <- results_ct
  signif_Koenig[[ct]]  <- signif_ct

  # write outputs
  fn_all   <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("Results_DE_Koenig_", ct, ".csv"))
  fn_sig   <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("Signif_DE_Koenig_", ct, ".csv"))
  fn_qc    <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("QC_DE_Koenig_", ct, ".txt"))

  write.csv(results_ct, file = fn_all, quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(signif_ct,  file = fn_sig, quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)

  # optional: small text QC log per celltype
  cat(
    paste0("cell_type: ", ct), "\n",
    paste0("n_cells: ", ncol(data_ct)), "\n",
    paste0("n_samples_kept: ", ncol(pb)), "\n",
    paste0("n_genes_tested: ", nrow(results_ct)), "\n",
    paste0("group_levels: ", paste(levels(group), collapse = ", ")), "\n",
    file = fn_qc
  )

  # cleanup inside loop (keeps memory stable)
  rm(data_ct, ct_cluster_col, expr_matrix, non_zero_cells, total_cells, percent_cells, percent_stats,
   keep_genes_pct, pb, keep_samples, metadata_ct, group, design, contrast,
   fit, results_ct, signif_ct)

  gc(verbose = FALSE)
}

# optional: write a summary table
write.csv(qc_Koenig, file = file.path(out_dir, "QC_summary_DE_Koenig_all_celltypes.csv"),
          quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r DE Reichart}
  }

qc_Reichart$n_cells[qc_Reichart$cell_type == ct] <- ncol(data_ct)


  # if too few cells, skip
  if (ncol(data_ct) < 100) {
    warning("Skipping ", ct, " (too few cells: ", ncol(data_ct), ")")
    next
  }

  # percent of cells expressing each gene (within this cell type)
  expr_matrix <- GetAssayData(object = data_ct, assay = "RNA", slot = "counts")
  non_zero_cells <- rowSums(expr_matrix > 0)
  total_cells <- ncol(expr_matrix)
  percent_cells <- (non_zero_cells / total_cells) * 100
  percent_stats <- data.frame(gene = rownames(expr_matrix), percentCells = percent_cells)

  keep_genes_pct <- rownames(dplyr::filter(percent_stats, percentCells > 1))

  # pseudobulk
  pb <- Seurat2PB(data_ct, sample = sample_col, cluster = ct_cluster_col)
  colnames(pb) <- pb$samples$sample

  # keep genes based on % cells
  pb <- pb[keep_genes_pct, ]

  # keep samples by lib size
  keep_samples <- pb$samples$lib.size > min_libsize
  pb <- pb[, keep_samples, keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
  qc_Reichart$n_samples_kept[qc_Reichart$cell_type == ct] <- ncol(pb)

  # if too few samples, skip
  if (ncol(pb) < 10) {
    warning("Skipping ", ct, " (too few samples after filtering: ", ncol(pb), ")")
    next
  }

  # match metadata to pseudobulk samples
  metadata_ct <- data_ct@meta.data %>%
    dplyr::select(!!sample_col, !!group_col, sex, Age_range, LVEF_percent, LVIDd_mm, LVIDs_mm, RVEDD_mm, TAPSE_mm, PAH, Hypertension, COPD) %>%
    unique()
  colnames(metadata_ct)[colnames(metadata_ct) == sample_col] <- "Sample"
  rownames(metadata_ct) <- metadata_ct$Sample

  metadata_ct <- metadata_ct[match(pb$samples$sample, metadata_ct$Sample), , drop = FALSE]

  # sanity check
  if (!all(metadata_ct$Sample == pb$samples$sample)) {
    stop("Sample order mismatch for cell type: ", ct)
  }

  if (!all(c("DCM", "HC") %in% levels(group))) {
    warning("Skipping ", ct, " (Group levels not as expected: ", paste(levels(group), collapse=", "), ")")
    next
  }

  design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + group)
  colnames(design) <- levels(group)

    DCM_vs_HC = DCM - HC,
    levels = design
  )

  )

  signif_Reichart[[ct]]  <- signif_ct

  # write outputs
  fn_all   <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("Results_DE_Reichart_", ct, ".csv"))
  fn_sig   <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("Signif_DE_Reichart_", ct, ".csv"))
  fn_qc    <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("QC_DE_Reichart_", ct, ".txt"))

  write.csv(results_ct, file = fn_all, quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(signif_ct,  file = fn_sig, quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)

  # optional: small text QC log per celltype
  cat(
    paste0("cell_type: ", ct), "\n",
    paste0("n_cells: ", ncol(data_ct)), "\n",
    paste0("n_samples_kept: ", ncol(pb)), "\n",
    paste0("n_genes_tested: ", nrow(results_ct)), "\n",

    file = fn_qc
  )

  # cleanup inside loop (keeps memory stable)
  rm(data_ct, ct_cluster_col, expr_matrix, non_zero_cells, total_cells, percent_cells, percent_stats,
   keep_genes_pct, pb, keep_samples, metadata_ct, group, design, contrast,
   fit, results_ct, signif_ct)
  gc(verbose = FALSE)
}
```

## Chaffin 2022

```{r Import Chaffin}
Chaffin <- readRDS("/scratch/gbonaz/Heart_datasets/Chaffin_2022/Chaffin.rds")
                   
Chaffin[["RNA"]] <- Chaffin[["originalexp"]]

DefaultAssay(Chaffin) <- "RNA"

Chaffin[["originalexp"]] <- NULL
```

```{r DE Chaffin}
# ---- settings ----
celltype_col <- "new_cell_type"   # your identity column
sample_col   <- "Sample"          # pseudobulk sample id
group_col    <- "Group"           # DCM vs NF

min_pct_cells_gene <- 1      # keep genes expressed in >1% of cells (within that cell type)
min_libsize        <- 5e4    # keep samples with pseudobulk lib.size > 5e4
fdr_thresh         <- 0.05
lfc_thresh         <- 0.5

out_dir <- here::here(output_dir_data, "DE_by_celltype_Chaffin")
if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)

# ---- containers ----
celltypes <- levels(Chaffin[[celltype_col]][, 1])
celltypes <- celltypes[!is.na(celltypes)]

# add "All_cells" as an extra pseudo cell type (runs DE on all cells together)
celltypes <- c("All_cells", celltypes)

results_Chaffin <- vector("list", length(celltypes))
signif_Chaffin  <- vector("list", length(celltypes))
names(results_Chaffin) <- celltypes
names(signif_Chaffin)  <- celltypes

# optional: collect basic QC / status per celltype
qc_Chaffin <- data.frame(
  cell_type = celltypes,
  n_cells = NA_integer_,
  n_samples_kept = NA_integer_,
  n_genes_tested = NA_integer_,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# ---- loop ----
for (ct in celltypes) {
  message("Running DE for cell type: ", ct)

  # subset to one cell type (special case: All_cells)
  if (ct == "All_cells") {
    data_ct <- Chaffin
    data_ct$celltype_all <- "All_cells"   # constant label for pseudobulk "cluster"
    ct_cluster_col <- "celltype_all"
  } else {
    data_ct <- subset(Chaffin, subset = !!as.name(celltype_col) == ct)
    ct_cluster_col <- celltype_col
  }

qc_Chaffin$n_cells[qc_Chaffin$cell_type == ct] <- ncol(data_ct)

  # if too few cells, skip
  if (ncol(data_ct) < 100) {
    warning("Skipping ", ct, " (too few cells: ", ncol(data_ct), ")")
    next
  }

  # percent of cells expressing each gene (within this cell type)
  expr_matrix <- GetAssayData(object = data_ct, assay = "RNA", slot = "counts")
  non_zero_cells <- rowSums(expr_matrix > 0)
  total_cells <- ncol(expr_matrix)
  percent_cells <- (non_zero_cells / total_cells) * 100
  percent_stats <- data.frame(gene = rownames(expr_matrix), percentCells = percent_cells)

  keep_genes_pct <- rownames(dplyr::filter(percent_stats, percentCells > 1))

  # pseudobulk
  pb <- Seurat2PB(data_ct, sample = sample_col, cluster = ct_cluster_col)
  colnames(pb) <- pb$samples$sample

  # keep genes based on % cells
  pb <- pb[keep_genes_pct, ]

  # keep samples by lib size
  keep_samples <- pb$samples$lib.size > min_libsize
  pb <- pb[, keep_samples, keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
  qc_Chaffin$n_samples_kept[qc_Chaffin$cell_type == ct] <- ncol(pb)

  # if too few samples, skip
  if (ncol(pb) < 10) {
    warning("Skipping ", ct, " (too few samples after filtering: ", ncol(pb), ")")
    next
  }

  # match metadata to pseudobulk samples
  metadata_ct <- data_ct@meta.data %>%
    dplyr::select(!!sample_col, !!group_col, sex, age, lvef, Body_Mass_Index_kg_m2, Heart_Weight_g, Left_Ventricular_Mass_g, Left_Ventricular_Mass_Index_g_m2, Left_Ventricular_End_Systolic_Dimension_cm, Left_Ventricular_End_Diastolic_Dimension_cm, Posterior_Wall_Thickness_cm) %>%
    unique()
  colnames(metadata_ct)[colnames(metadata_ct) == sample_col] <- "Sample"
  rownames(metadata_ct) <- metadata_ct$Sample

  metadata_ct <- metadata_ct[match(pb$samples$sample, metadata_ct$Sample), , drop = FALSE]

  # sanity check
  if (!all(metadata_ct$Sample == pb$samples$sample)) {
    stop("Sample order mismatch for cell type: ", ct)
  }

  group <- factor(metadata_ct[[group_col]])
  if (!all(c("DCM", "NF") %in% levels(group))) {
    warning("Skipping ", ct, " (Group levels not as expected: ", paste(levels(group), collapse=", "), ")")
    next
  }

  design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + group)
  colnames(design) <- levels(group)

  contrast <- makeContrasts(
    DCM_vs_HC = DCM - NF,
    levels = design
  )

  # edgeR pipeline (as in your code)
  pb <- normLibSizes(pb)
  pb <- estimateDisp(pb, design)

  fit <- glmQLFit(pb, design, robust = TRUE)
  fit <- glmQLFTest(fit, contrast = contrast)

  results_ct <- topTags(fit, n = Inf)$table
  results_ct$gene <- rownames(results_ct)

  # merge percent expressed
  results_ct <- merge(results_ct, percent_stats[, c("gene", "percentCells")], by = "gene", all.x = FALSE)

  # up/down annotation (same thresholds as you used)
  results_ct$diff_exp <- ifelse(
    results_ct$logFC >  lfc_thresh & results_ct$FDR < fdr_thresh, "Increased",
    ifelse(results_ct$logFC < -lfc_thresh & results_ct$FDR < fdr_thresh, "Decreased", "Not significant")
  )

  signif_ct <- results_ct %>%
    dplyr::filter(FDR < fdr_thresh, abs(logFC) > lfc_thresh) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(FDR)

  qc_Chaffin$n_genes_tested[qc_Chaffin$cell_type == ct] <- nrow(results_ct)

  # store in lists
  results_Chaffin[[ct]] <- results_ct
  signif_Chaffin[[ct]]  <- signif_ct

  # write outputs
  fn_all   <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("Results_DE_Chaffin_", ct, ".csv"))
  fn_sig   <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("Signif_DE_Chaffin_", ct, ".csv"))
  fn_qc    <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("QC_DE_Chaffin_", ct, ".txt"))

  write.csv(results_ct, file = fn_all, quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(signif_ct,  file = fn_sig, quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)

  # optional: small text QC log per celltype
  cat(
    paste0("cell_type: ", ct), "\n",
    paste0("n_cells: ", ncol(data_ct)), "\n",
    paste0("n_samples_kept: ", ncol(pb)), "\n",
    paste0("n_genes_tested: ", nrow(results_ct)), "\n",
    paste0("group_levels: ", paste(levels(group), collapse = ", ")), "\n",
    file = fn_qc
  )

  # cleanup inside loop (keeps memory stable)
  rm(data_ct, ct_cluster_col, expr_matrix, non_zero_cells, total_cells, percent_cells, percent_stats,
   keep_genes_pct, pb, keep_samples, metadata_ct, group, design, contrast,
   fit, results_ct, signif_ct)
  gc(verbose = FALSE)
}

# optional: write a summary table
write.csv(qc_Chaffin, file = file.path(out_dir, "QC_summary_DE_Chaffin_all_celltypes.csv"),
          quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
```


## Merge results

```{r}
celltypes <- sort(unique(c(
  names(results_Koenig),
  names(results_Reichart),
  names(results_Chaffin)
)))

pick_and_rename <- function(df, tag) {
  df %>%
    dplyr::select(gene, logFC, FDR, percentCells, diff_exp) %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      !!paste0("logFC_", tag)        := logFC,
      !!paste0("FDR_", tag)          := FDR,
      !!paste0("percentCells_", tag) := percentCells,
      !!paste0("diff_exp_", tag)     := diff_exp
    )
}

merged_results_all <- setNames(vector("list", length(celltypes)), celltypes)

for (ct in celltypes) {
  dfs <- list(
    Koenig   = results_Koenig[[ct]],
    Reichart = results_Reichart[[ct]],
    Chaffin  = results_Chaffin[[ct]]
  )

  dfs <- purrr::imap(dfs, ~ if (is.null(.x)) NULL else pick_and_rename(.x, .y)) %>%
    purrr::compact()

  if (length(dfs) == 0) {
    merged_results_all[[ct]] <- NULL
    next
  }

  merged_ct <- purrr::reduce(dfs, dplyr::full_join, by = "gene")

# enforce column order
ordered_cols <- c(
  "gene",
  paste0("diff_exp_",    c("Koenig", "Reichart", "Chaffin")),
  paste0("logFC_",        c("Koenig", "Reichart", "Chaffin")),
  paste0("FDR_",          c("Koenig", "Reichart", "Chaffin")),
  paste0("percentCells_",c("Koenig", "Reichart", "Chaffin"))
  
)

merged_results_all[[ct]] <- merged_ct[, intersect(ordered_cols, colnames(merged_ct))]

}
```

```{r}
merged_results_df <- imap_dfr(
  merged_results_all,
  ~ if (is.null(.x)) NULL else
      dplyr::mutate(.x, cell_type = .y, .after = gene)
)

write.csv(merged_results_df, file = here::here(output_dir_data, "Diff_exp_merged_results.csv"), quote=F, row.names = F)

reactable(merged_results_df, 
          filterable = TRUE,
          searchable = TRUE,
          showPageSizeOptions = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(survcomp)

min_studies <- 1  

meta_combined_results <- merged_results_df %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    lfc_cols <- grep("^logFC_", names(.x), value = TRUE)
    fdr_cols <- grep("^FDR_",  names(.x), value = TRUE)
    percent_cols <- grep("^percentCells_", names(.x), value = TRUE)

    mean_logFC <- rowMeans(.x[, lfc_cols, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
    mean_percentCells <- rowMeans(.x[, percent_cols, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)

    n_studies <- rowSums(!is.na(.x[, fdr_cols, drop = FALSE]))

    combined_p <- apply(.x[, fdr_cols, drop = FALSE], 1, function(p) {
      p <- as.numeric(p)
      p <- p[!is.na(p)]
      if (length(p) < min_studies) return(NA_real_)  
      survcomp::combine.test(p, method = "fisher", na.rm = TRUE) 
    })

    meta_q <- p.adjust(combined_p, method = "BH")

    tibble(
      gene = .x$gene,
      n_studies = n_studies,
      mean_logFC = mean_logFC,
      fishher_p = combined_p,
      fishher_fdr = meta_q,
      mean_percentCells = mean_percentCells
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

write.csv(meta_combined_results, file = here::here(output_dir_data, "Diff_exp_meta_conbined_results.csv"), quote=F, row.names = F)

reactable(meta_combined_results, 
          filterable = TRUE,
          searchable = TRUE,
          showPageSizeOptions = TRUE)
```
